label: Task-5
title: Design domain architecture for issuesFS.ai
description: The stakeholder has acquired the issuesFS.ai domain. Design the subdomain/path architecture mapping all the websites the ecosystem needs. Consider: (1) Main site at issuesFS.ai _ project landing page, what is Issues-FS, getting started, links to all repos. (2) Journalist news site _ could be news.issuesFS.ai or issuesFS.ai/news. (3) Documentation site (from Issues-FS__Docs) _ docs.issuesFS.ai. (4) API/Service docs _ api.issuesFS.ai. (5) Future role sites _ e.g. maps.issuesFS.ai for Cartographer visualizations, library.issuesFS.ai for Librarian knowledge base. (6) PyPI package pages. Produce an ADR covering: subdomain vs path-based routing, which repos serve which sites, GitHub Pages CNAME setup for each, DNS records needed, SSL/TLS (GitHub Pages handles this), phased rollout plan. Reference ADR-001 (Jekyll news site, now Accepted) as the first site to deploy. The Journalist site should be first, main landing page second.
